from textutils import is_palindrome, slugify

assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "expected"),
    [
        ("racecar", True),
        ("RaceCar", True),
        ("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama", True),
        ("No 'x' in Nixon", True),
        ("\tNever odd\nor even\t", True),
        ("", True),
        (" ,.! ", True),
        ("a", True),
        ("12321", True),
        ("12, 31", False),
        ("Été", True),
        ("hello", False),
        ("Almost a palindrome!", False),
    ],
)
def test_is_palindrome(text: str, expected: bool) -> None:
    assert is_palindrome(text) is expected
